title: Brave browser profiles
whyItMatters: Each Brave profile is a separate browsing identity with its own history, bookmarks and wallets. Its presence shows the browser was used and how many identities were kept apart.
source: Chromium user data directory docs (Brave uses the Chromium layout under BraveSoftware/Brave-Browser): https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/docs/user_data_dir.md
notes: Matches the Preferences marker file so non-profile folders are skipped. Brave Browser Beta and Nightly use separate folders next to this one.
